text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The victor of the Japanese Derby is my 
archrival. Yet she put everything on the 
line, captivating everyone with her 
furiously passionate run.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battlefield turned into a 
radiant hall! Echoing all around are 
cheers! Cheers! Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, a thorough examination after the 
race revealed an abnormality in her left 
leg. A return to racing was deemed 
hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My friend devised race plans for that 
"aftermath." Misguided accusations blamed 
the Trainer's guidance. Yet—all of it is 
in vain. Enough is enough.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Here lies the finest demise for me, who 
has achieved greatness. "Never mind what 
comes after." It simply means that the 
"after" has finally arrived.
